said.q: The artwork titled “Fire in Hoboken, facing Manhattan” is a photograph taken by Henri Cartier-Bresson in 1947. This evocative black-and-white image captures the aftermath of a fire in Hoboken, with the distant skyline of Manhattan visible through the smoky haze.
said.by: Pop Art Masters Gallery, on Artsy
